receipt.decision_requirement: PASS only when every required artifact, linkage, closure, loss, deadline, and cleanup condition is authenticated. Any missing, inconsistent, or unverifiable field is BLOCKED.
receipt.run_id_policy: One nonempty immutable run_id must be identical in the receipt, privileged result/review, every artifact descriptor, every raw record, every normalized event, every PID/netns join record, coverage/loss output, PCAP hash source, and post-cleanup proof. Omitted row-level run_id is BLOCKED.
receipt.artifact_hash_policy: Each required artifact descriptor must name a relative path below the one declared receipt root, a positive byte count except where an empty file is explicitly prohibited, and a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 matching the received bytes. The PCAP hash source is separate and mandatory.

raw_audit_record.serial_policy: serial is an exact integer audit serial and is unique within the raw audit JSONL.
raw_audit_record.raw_bytes_policy: raw_bytes_b64 must strict-decode. The SHA-256 of decoded bytes must equal raw_sha256. No rendered-text substitute is accepted.

normalized_event.raw_link_policy: raw_serial must select exactly one raw record. Decoded normalized raw_event_bytes_b64 must equal that raw record decoded bytes, and raw_event_sha256 must equal both decoded-byte SHA-256 values.

file_read_or_write.path_identity_policy: The normalized watched_path must equal the exact PATH name from the same raw audit serial and must be present in the normalized file identity.

pid_netns_logical_host_join.match_policy: Every normalized event must match exactly one join record on run_id, logical_host_id, pid, pid_start_time_ticks/start_ticks, and netns_inode. No host identity may be inferred.

pcap_authentication.match_policy: The PCAP SHA-256 must appear in the declared PCAP hash-source artifact and equal the hash of the PCAP bytes. A filename-only, review-only, or inferred binding is BLOCKED.

post_cleanup.restoration_policy: Only rules proven added by the same run may be removed. The post-cleanup baseline hash must exactly equal the pre-run baseline hash.

consumer_boundary.future_consumer_rule: A future independent consumer must re-hash receipt artifacts, recompute raw/normalized serial and decoded-byte links, reject broken joins, require positive FILE_READ_OR_WRITE evidence, and not synthesize a file event.
